items.title: DoCtOR: agent-level attribution as a repair target
items.html: Wang, Huang, Liang, Li, Du, Pan, arXiv 2608.28264 (EMNLP 2026; Mon 31 Aug announce). Attributes failure to a specific agent, counterfactual-corrects that agent's error step, reflects only there — +22 / +26 / +27 pts success on HotPotQA / ChartQAPro / Mind2Web vs Reflexion/Retroformer/COPPER. Agent-level (not step-exact) attribution is the actionable grain; supports fault_edge + fault_side. Full brief.

items.title: Fidelity Is Not Enough: dispatch logs catch silent fabrication
items.html: arXiv 2608.28439 (Mon 31 Aug announce). Datasheet-extraction agent passed fidelity checks while one model never opened the source — structured-output constraints disabled tool use; fabricated source text. Rule-based + silent-failure detectors on tool-call logs: 50/50 planted faults, 0 FP across 207 fidelity-passing extractions. Near-verbatim case for trajectory_verified beside match_golden_qa. Full brief.

items.title: CURA: certified alarms from harness-visible telemetry only
items.html: arXiv 2608.27808 (Mon 31 Aug announce). External monitor for computer-use agents: CUSUM on harness-visible logs only (no model internals, no extra LLM). Detects 42.3% of failures a median 31 steps early; 0.828 AUROC; certificate bounds false alarms only, not recall. SQL twin of deterministic session flags over agent_events. Full brief.

items.title: OBPE: out-of-band enforcement at the tool boundary
items.html: arXiv 2608.27646 (Mon 31 Aug announce). HTTP proxy + Cedar policies between agent and backends; typed operation/resource auth; trace failures 57.6%→0.2% across 3,621 trials; task fulfillment 79.1%→60.9%. Reference for why runtime guardrails stay do-not-start for BQAA — enforcement is someone else's layer; its decisions land in the warehouse as rows. Full brief.

items.title: RealSWE: realistic prompts cost 6.4 points
items.html: arXiv 2608.27831 (Mon 31 Aug announce). 381 multi-variant task families; real user requests are problem-statement-only 88% of the time (vs 7% of benchmarks) and casual 87% (vs 94% formal). Realistic phrasing costs coding agents 6.4 pts resolution on average. Golden sets from curated formal text will overstate production success vs the 0.92 golden-matching threshold. Full brief.

items.title: Trace-to-fix agents are the product now
items.html: LangSmith Engine (May beta) and Arize Signal / Managed Agents (GA 29 Jul) cluster production traces and open PRs. The store is no longer the demo.

progress.html: Engine’s 25 Aug post ships self-hosted VPC orchestration (LangSmith Intelligence, ZDR), claimed >2× IssueBench and +25% Terminal-Bench on proposed fixes, Slack/Linear, Reduced Analysis. Same job as Signal (Enterprise PRs, promo through 15 Sep). 2× is first-party; auto-verify of fixes is still unshipped. BQAA still wins the warehouse and loses the demo unless it names a trace→cluster→dataset loop.

Fable 5: Engine is a consumer of LangSmith’s store, not a new store. Self-hosted keeps orchestration in-VPC; inference still leaves for LSI and hard-fails without it. Verification of proposed fixes is roadmap, not shipped. BQAA has the primitives and no named cluster→dataset recipe. Full brief.
Fable 5: Engine’s primary page did not move. AgentDebugX shows the half that moves outcomes is Detect → Rerun, not Attribute. Arize Signal is now subordinate to the Dynatrace close. Full brief.

Fable 5: weekly rollup through 31 Aug — ABAC on matching project traces, thread evaluations compose with trace/tree filters, Engine usage-credit costs cut 40%, and Gateway PII redaction is now a separately billed entitlement. Full brief.

items.title: Databricks is the only warehouse peer
items.html: OTel traces into Unity Catalog Delta via Zerobus, SQL scorers, UC ACLs. Same pitch: join traces to business data; don’t send prompts to a SaaS.

progress.html: Fable 5: Databricks stores raw OTel spans, so it inherits 0-of-63-stable churn as columns. BQAA’s ADK schema + trace_id join is insulated. Docs (19 Aug) default quota is 10,000 req/s; the blog still says 200 QPS.

Fable 5: unified trace table is Beta (notes 21 Aug, docs 28 Aug) — a gateway log, one OTel span per row, not the MLflow/Zerobus path. Shared multi-hop trace IDs “coming soon.” Analog is a Vertex request log, not agent_events. Full brief.

items.title: OTel GenAI is still Development
items.html: Conventions moved to semantic-conventions-genai (repo 5 May; core v1.42.0 on 12 Jun stripped gen_ai.*). Production mixes v1.36 and v1.37+ names. BQAA still does not export OTel spans; it joins on trace_id.

progress.html: As of 21 Aug the dedicated repo still has no tagged release. 0 of 63 gen_ai attributes are stable. Python instrumentation flip can silently blank dashboards keyed on old names. “OTel-native” in Aug 2026 is still a Development convention.
Fable 5: do not claim “OTel-native.” Keep ADK events as system of record; treat gen_ai.* as a COALESCE projection.

Fable 5: still 0 of 63 gen_ai attributes stable; no tagged release. ADK #5889 is closed — plugin emits no OTel spans since 2.2.0. Databricks gateway table and the LangChain handler are fresh consumers of the unstable vocabulary. Full brief.

Fable 5: verified-flat hour — PyPI 0.5.1, adk-python v2.8.0, adk-java v1.8.0, GCP BQAA page Aug 26, BigQuery notes end Aug 27, OTel GenAI zero releases, vendor changelogs unchanged; arXiv still closed since Fri Aug 28. No new first-party fact. Full brief.

items.title: Amplitude claimed the name
items.html: Product analytics on conversations this month: funnels, retention, identity. Not a trace debugger. That’s the business-insights story packaged as a product.

progress.html: GA 20 Aug on every plan, including free. 28 Aug names privacy modes full / metadata_only / customer_enriched. Pitch is shared user_id with product events. Caps 5k–20k sessions/month; chat retained 14 or 30 days. Threat is the PM buyer, not debugging.

Fable 5: Amplitude owns the PM buyer and the phrase “agent analytics.” BQAA can do the user_id join; Amplitude ships it. One documented cohort recipe (failing rubric → 30-day retention) is the counter.

items.title: AER is the closest paper to BQAA
items.html: Oracle AER (Vispute & Kadam, Mar 2026) treats population-level behavioral analytics as a first-class schema (intent / observation / inference), not NLP over traces. Empirical validation still preliminary. Then IBM ABBench. Failure taxonomies: TRAIL / MAST / Who&When. Yehudai et al., Findings of ACL 2026 says developer eval frameworks cannot aggregate across large run collections.

progress.html: Fable 5: AER is still the closest schema paper (intent / observation / inference + verdict with confidence and evidence_chain). Empirical validation remains preliminary; reasoning fields are self-report.

items.title: UModel: warehouse as entity graph, not raw SQL
items.html: Pei et al., arXiv 2606.04799 (June 2026, Alibaba Cloud: millions of ops/s). Object graph plus pipe queries. Agents on raw PromQL/SQL sit under 5% query accuracy; entity PaaS tools add the points. Do not ship “here is agent_events, write SQL” as the agent API.

progress.html: Fable 5: agents on raw SQL/PromQL sit under 5% query accuracy. The stale skill repo (last commit 4 May) is BQAA’s entity-tool layer and is the Monday fix.

items.title: LongRCA: production RCA is still unsolved
items.html: Zhang, Feng, Pei et al., arXiv 2608.15242 (Aug 2026). 1,140 natural failed traces, median 145 steps, max 728. Best method 51.1% role / 24.1% exact root. Injected-error benches overstate. Should gate #435: session-level EvalBench MVP is fine; do not claim span forensics until traces this long survive.

progress.html: Fable 5: 24.1% exact root step, 51.1% role, human agreement 39.5% / 65.9%. This gates #435: session-level EvalBench MVP is fine; do not claim span forensics.
Fable 5: TelemetrySuffBench does not contradict LongRCA — it brackets it. On real public traces, Full-view origin-step is 9.6–24.3% (TraceElephant), the same band as LongRCA’s 24.1%. Full brief.

Fable 5: verified-flat hour — PyPI 0.5.1, adk-python v2.8.0, adk-java v1.8.0, GCP BQAA page Aug 26, BigQuery notes end Aug 27, OTel GenAI zero releases, vendor changelogs unchanged; arXiv still closed since Fri Aug 28. No new first-party fact. Full brief.

Fable 5: DoCtOR (2608.28264, EMNLP) uses agent-level failure attribution as a repair target (+22–27 pts) — outside support that coarse-grain attribution is actionable even when step-exact localization stays weak. Full brief.

Fable 5: AgentEval (2604.23581) — evaluation DAGs with recorded dependency edges: 0.89 vs 0.41 failure-detection recall; +22/+34 pts from edges existing at all; 72% RCA vs 81% human ceiling. LongRCA's 24.1% is what attribution looks like without structure; attribution is schema-starved, not hopeless. Fold parent_step_id into EV #7. Full brief.

items.title: Langfuse v4 is the missed platform ship
items.html: v4 GA 17 Aug. Observations-first ClickHouse. Cloud becomes v4-only on 16 Nov 2026. No Engine/Signal equivalent. Pitch BQAA on joins and retention, not query latency.

progress.html: Fable 5: v4 converged on BQAA’s row shape (append-only observations, user/session on every row). Pitch joins and retention, not latency. Nov 16 is the Cloud cutover.

Fable 5: v4.23.0 (28 Aug) adds toolCallInvocations as a first-class measure and evaluator version restore; v4.24.0 is housekeeping. Nov 16 v4-only Cloud deadline unchanged. BQAA copy: named v_tool_invocations view and judge_version + rubric content hash. Full brief.

Fable 5: v4.25.0 (31 Aug ~3:42 AM PT, three days after v4.24.0). Evaluator output definitions described through MCP; normalized I/O contract and projections; OTel attribute-path reconstruction and child-trace name denormalization. Peer is formalizing producer contracts and machine-readable eval definitions — copy the shape for EvalBench describe_rubric(). Full brief.

Links evaluator execution traces (judge run becomes an openable, linked trace); guards structured judge output against reasoning collisions; tags metadata_dropped at OTel ingestion. Peer evidence for EV #7 (judge runs in agent_events / judge_version + rubric hash) and EV #3 (in-band drop facts / get_drop_stats()). Full brief.

items.html: EvalBench reader, 8-metric rubrics, golden matching at 0.92. Consume SDK, not the capture plugin.

Fable 5 consume loop: cluster session-level failures → write a dataset → re-score with 0.5.1 rubrics / golden 0.92. Call the output table issues. Persist scores on trace_id / invocation_id, not session_id. Brief.

Fable 5: 0.5.1 still the tag (main is 3fb6a00, #450). EvalBench importer is PR 451 (merge first) and PR 452 (do not merge at e384695: circular superseded-generation ownership; no manifest migration). Full brief.

items.title: #435 is an open RFC, not a PR
items.html: AgentForensics failure taxonomy. Plan v3 is a 6-week EvalBench-only session-level MVP. Last review: do not start the clock until the P1s are closed.

progress.html: Comments through 20:21 PT iterated the RFC to plan v4. Reviewers flagged SANA (arXiv 2606.13904) as adjacent. Still: do not start the clock until P1s and the partner/job are named.

Fable 5: do not start the clock. SANA (2606.13904) abstract is a component-ablation on LakeQA/KramaBench, not a seven-category taxonomy on Strands — re-read before treating as prior art. P1s (counterfactual gate, uncertainty, D4) are each backed by a paper.

Fable 5: do not start the #435 clock (0/5 week-0 gate). Slice 1 PR 451 is agent-review-complete; do not merge PR 452 at e384695 (two P1s). Snapshot consistency (an engineering prerequisite) is closed by 451. Full brief.

items.title: Who&When Pro is the failure enum to steal
items.html: arXiv 2607.09996 (10 Jul): 12,326 traces, 18-mode taxonomy. Frontier models ~74% text-step accuracy, ~22% error-mode F1. Use the taxonomy in #435; do not trust injected labels as a production prior.

progress.html: Fable 5: steal the 18-mode enum; do not trust injected labels as a production prior. Error-mode F1 ~22%. Combine with MAST’s 14 (κ 0.88 in the abstract, not 0.77).

Fable 5: Model or Harness (arXiv 2607.28802) says the unit of attribution is fault_edge + fault_side, not a 19th mode. Who&When Pro’s 18 modes remain the what; replace responsible_role with edge+side. Full brief.

items.html: Industry + academy → BQAA. 36 sections, 10:24 PM PT. Analysis is Claude Code Fable 5; this catalog only appends. Highest-EV: v_tool_repeat view, named cluster→dataset→re-score loop, OpenAI Evals guide before Oct 31. Do not start #435.

items.title: TRCA: deterministic step flags, not a learned PRM
items.html: Zhang et al., arXiv 2608.16156 (17 Aug). Evidence / Execution / Invalidity per transition; Breakthrough paid only on first coverage. 96.5% of early rollouts fail yet 72.2% of failed-trajectory actions still carry signal. Warehouse schema: invalid_tool_rate, thrash, first-coverage latency. No LLM required.

items.title: Graphectory: phase graphs for coding-agent logs
items.html: OOPSLA 2026 + ASE 2026 viewer. 4,000 SWE-agent/OpenHands runs; 35,664-line logs compress to ~35 nodes. 5-person forensics 8% → 84% vs the CLI viewer. Maps onto Claude Code / Codex OTLP producers: a phase column and loop detection as SQL.

items.title: TRACE: multi-pass monitors, not one LLM over the trace
items.html: Mittapalli et al., arXiv 2606.07054. Triage–Inspect–Judge on SHADE-Arena (avg 91.8 turns). Claude Sonnet 4.6 F1 0.713 vs full-trajectory 0.577. Template for any BQAA judge: materialize suspect windows in SQL, persist evidence, judge the log.

items.title: DoVer: attribution is a hypothesis until you replay
items.html: Ma et al., ICLR 2026. 14/29 Who&When GAIA labels were uncertain. Interventions flip 18–28% of Magentic-One failures; end-of-trace critique flipped 0%. Gates #435: report % hypotheses validated, not judge accuracy vs a single gold step. Hook is AGENT_STATE_CHECKPOINT.

items.title: Yehudai: warehouse aggregation is the missing layer
items.html: Findings of ACL 2026 (also arXiv 2503.16416). Developer eval frameworks (LangSmith, Langfuse, Vertex, Arize) cannot derive insights across large run collections. Direct product implication for BQAA’s consume side.

items.title: SANA is not a taxonomy paper
items.html: arXiv 2606.13904. The #435 thread described a seven-category taxonomy and two-stage LLM audit on Strands. The abstract is a component-ablation over LakeQA/KramaBench (data analysis is the bottleneck). Re-read the PDF before citing as prior art.

items.title: Monday: v_tool_repeat view
items.html: Highest-EV SQL in the Fable 5 brief: group TOOL_STARTING by invocation_id, tool name, and a hash of the args, HAVING COUNT(*) > k. This is Arize’s 43× get_datasets loop with OK spans. No LLM. No #435. Ships as an SDK view.

progress.html: Fable 5: highest-EV is now deterministic session flags (loop, latency_outlier, misroute, overflow, status='ERROR') plus a non-decaying session risk latch, not v_tool_repeat alone. Full brief.

Fable 5: CURA (2608.27808) — CUSUM alarms on harness-visible telemetry catch 42.3% of failures a median 31 steps early; contract bounds false alarms only. Strengthens the deterministic session-flag lane. Full brief.

items.title: Dynatrace buys Arize for $915M
items.html: Definitive agreement (13 Aug): Dynatrace acquires Arize for $915M (~$815M cash + replacement equity). Close Q2 or early Q3 FY2027. Phoenix/OpenInference unmentioned. An evaluation-layer buy, not a warehouse store of record. Full brief.

items.title: TelemetrySuffBench: localization is the telemetry
items.html: Zhu & Pu, arXiv 2608.07899 (submitted 8 Aug). Detection F1 99.5–100%; origin-step ≤0.5% on OTel/OpenInference; drop decision content → 0%; real traces 9.6–24.3% (LongRCA band). Binding constraint is what the row contains. Full brief.

progress.html: Fable 5: Monday batch theme is detection/attribution from logged telemetry alone (DoCtOR, CURA, Fidelity Is Not Enough) — no new TelemetrySuffBench version; thesis unchanged, outside evidence up. Full brief.

items.title: PR 451 merge-ready; do not merge 452 at e384695
items.html: Do not start the #435 clock (0/5 week-0 gate). PR 451 agent-review-complete — merge first. Do not merge PR 452 at e384695 (two P1s: circular superseded-generation ownership; no manifest migration). Full brief.

items.title: Agent Mesh: loops of successful identical calls
items.html: Shaikh, Bombarde, Pathak, arXiv 2608.26225 (submitted 26 Aug). 147 incidents; 54 successful identical calls invisible to error-rate breakers; effects accumulate across six invocations. Re-key v_tool_repeat on (tool, args_sha256, result_sha256), not status='ERROR'. Full brief.

items.title: Verdict Staleness: approvals expire between check and use
items.html: Shraga, Eshel, Gorelik, arXiv 2608.26306 (26 Aug; IEEE ACSOS 2026). Freshness contract: 5.3–48.4% verdict change between check and use. Ship v_approval_age; reserve checked_context_sha256, grounding_ts, expiry_rule, fallback on GUARDRAIL_DECISION. Full brief.

items.title: CTF-ABACUS: only 62–87% of successes are trace-verified
items.html: Milner, Shao, Rani et al., arXiv 2608.26237 (26 Aug). 1,435 attempts; 13–38% of matching outputs skip the required work. Add trajectory_verified beside match_golden_qa (answer matched and required tools observed). Full brief.

progress.html: Fable 5: Monday paper Fidelity Is Not Enough (2608.28439) — fidelity-passing answers with fabricated sources; only tool-dispatch logs caught all 50 planted faults (0 FP). Independent evidence for trajectory_verified. Full brief.

Fable 5: ClawTrack (2607.28037) — dual Task/Process scores, 12,541 rubrics, result verification the systematic bottleneck. Third paper in four days for trajectory-over-answer; dual-threshold trajectory_verified beside match_golden_qa. Full brief.

items.title: Same model, different harness: 28% → 49%
items.html: Lewis, arXiv 2608.26218 (26 Aug). Holding model and task fixed, a harness change moved SWE-bench Verified fail-to-pass 28% → 49%. Put ADK version, compaction policy, and EVENT_COMPACTION count on the eval manifest so fault_side = harness is populatable. Full brief.

items.title: ClawTrack: process scores filter lucky passes
items.html: Wu et al., arXiv 2607.28037 (submitted 30 Jul). Dual Task Score + Process Score; 12,541 rubric items across 320 tasks / 8 domains; result verification is the systematic bottleneck. Trajectory filtering on process scores yields post-training gains. Third independent paper in four days (after Fidelity Is Not Enough and CURA) that truth lives in the trajectory. Dual-threshold trajectory_verified beside match_golden_qa. Full brief.

items.title: AgentEval: attribution works when the schema records the edges
items.html: Guo, Wu, Yiu, arXiv 2604.23581 (submitted 26 Apr). Evaluation DAGs: LLM-judged nodes, 21-subcategory failures, upstream dependency edges. 450 cases: failure-detection recall 0.89 vs 0.41 (2.17×); dependency modeling +22 detection / +34 RCA; 72% RCA vs 81% human ceiling; 4-month pilot 4.2h → 22 min. LongRCA's 24.1% is attribution without recorded structure. Fold parent_step_id into fault_edge / fault_side. Full brief.
